newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Dutch Queen Beatrix to visit S.Africa in October.
newsitem.headline: Dutch Queen Beatrix to visit S.Africa in October.

text.p: Queen Beatrix of The Netherlands will pay a four-day state visit to South Africa in October, the first by a ruling Dutch monarch, the South African foreign ministry said on Thursday.
She will be accompanied by several officials who will sign a cultural agreement with South Africa, where the Dutch were the first European settlers in 1652.
The queen will be accompanied by her husband Prince Claus on the September 30 to October 3 visit.
